# Net Automotive Detailing
> Premium mobile auto detailing serving all of Oahu, Hawaii. We bring interior, exterior, and restoration services directly to your driveway, condo, or worksite — no drop-off required.

## Contact
- Phone: (808) 777-8964
- Email: office@netautomotivedetailing.com
- Hours: By appointment, 7 days a week
- Website: https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com
- Google Business Profile: https://share.google/LLJOh43qIRwYpN4AD
- Service Area: All of Oahu, Hawaii

## Services
- [Interior Detail](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/services/interior-detail): Full interior cleaning — vacuum, steam, dashboard, console, windows, deodorize.
- [Exterior Detail](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/services/exterior-detail): Hand wash, decontamination, dry, dressing, tire shine.
- [Carpet Shampoo](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/services/carpet-shampoo): Hot-water extraction for carpets and floor mats.
- [Seat Shampoo](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/services/seat-shampoo): Deep extraction cleaning for cloth seats.
- [Leather Conditioning](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/services/leather-conditioning): pH-balanced cleaning and UV-protective conditioning.
- [Clay Bar Treatment](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/services/clay-bar-treatment): Removes embedded contaminants; preps surface for wax.
- [Exterior Spray Wax](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/services/exterior-spray-wax): Quick-application paint protection and gloss boost.
- [Rim Detailing](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/services/rim-detailing): Deep cleaning of wheel barrels, faces, and lugs.
- [Headlight Restoration](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/services/headlight-restoration): Sand, polish, and seal cloudy headlights.
- [Plastic Color Restoration](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/services/plastic-color-restoration): Restore faded black plastic trim.

## Service Areas
- [Honolulu](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/honolulu): Urban Oahu — condos, downtown professionals, Waikiki.
- [Kailua](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/kailua): Windward beach town — salt air and sandy interiors.
- [Kapolei](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/kapolei): West side — family vehicles and commuter SUVs.
- [Kaneohe](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/kaneohe): Windward rain belt — mildew prevention and military community.
- [Pearl City](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/pearl-city): High-mileage commuter cars and daily drivers.
- [Aiea](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/aiea): Pearl Harbor-adjacent — shipyard and military households.
- [Ewa Beach](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/ewa-beach): Coastal salt air and fast-growing residential.
- [Mililani](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/mililani): Planned community — family fleets and two-car households.
- [Hawaii Kai](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/hawaii-kai): Marina-side luxury market.
- [Haleiwa](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/haleiwa): North Shore surf town — truck and Jeep lifestyle.
- [Wahiawa](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/wahiawa): Central plateau — military-adjacent and red-dirt cleanup.
- [Waialua](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/waialua): North Shore agricultural — dust and rural roads.
- [Waimalu](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/waimalu): Pearl City-adjacent residential community.
- [Manoa](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/manoa): UH and Manoa Valley — rain and humidity care.
- [Waimanalo Beach](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/waimanalo-beach): Windward beach community — sand-heavy interiors.
- [Kaimuki](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/kaimuki): Historic Honolulu neighborhood with on-street parking.
- [Royal Kunia](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/royal-kunia): Newer suburb — family SUVs and trucks.
- [Ewa Villages](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/ewa-villages): Historic plantation neighborhood.
- [Schofield Barracks](https://www.netautomotivedetailing.com/service-areas/schofield-barracks): Military community — PCS and deployment-ready detailing.
